name: Zezhao Wu
about: Hi! I'm Zezhao Wu, an undergraduate studying Biological Science at Tsinghua University, with graduation expected in June 2027. I am interested in how the brain represents the visual world and how the dynamics of these representations support perception and behavior.

news.text: Our preprint on learning continuous updating of neural population activity from sparse time samples is available on bioRxiv.
I worked with Ning Qian at Columbia University's Center for Theoretical Neuroscience as a summer research intern.
I attended the Cognitive Computational Neuroscience Conference. My unofficial role was full-time audience member, with no poster or talk of my own.
Graph of Trace is available in the ACL System Demonstrations proceedings.
I joined a student-organized academic visit to the UK, visiting the University of Cambridge, the University of Oxford, and the John Innes Centre.
I began my undergraduate studies in Biological Science at Tsinghua University.

publications.title: Learning continuous updating and control of neural population activities from sparse time samples
publications.authors: Zezhao Wu, Mingsha Zhang, and Ning Qian
publications.summary: A continuity-equation constraint helps recurrent neural networks learn continuous population updating from supervision at sparse time points.
publications.imageAlt: Recurrent neural network schematic, connection profiles, and population activity during transsaccadic updating.
